sessions_card: Your sessions for the next 2 weeks
sessions_card_meta: One sheet per session: brand, trainer, venue, dates and seats taken. One click opens what is left to prepare.
sessions_empty: No session in the next 2 weeks.
rooms_meta: One room for each session, without any room booked twice.
trainees_meta: One by one or from an Excel list, and replace those who drop out.
travel_meta: Flights, hotel, shuttles and visa for each trainee, with what they cost.
invites_meta: Before the session, then whenever the date or place changes.
certificates_meta: At the end of the training, once attendance is recorded.
calendar_meta: All the sessions of the year, with their rooms.
shares_meta: What each subsidiary pays this year for its training seats. The coordinator keeps it up to date.
